cases.prompt: Is src/greeter.js over-engineered? What can we delete?
expectations: Flags the abstract strategy, single-implementation strategy, and factory whose default branch duplicates en as speculative generality
Flags the unused config options (retries, enableCache by default off, padWidth 0) and the cache as dead or premature
Flags left-pad (String.prototype.padStart) and is-odd (i % 2) as unneeded dependencies
Proposes a small replacement (a greet function) with an estimate of lines removed, and does not modify files

cases.prompt: What can we simplify or delete in src/slug.js?
expectations: Says the code is already simple and does not invent abstractions to remove

cases.prompt: Rename the Greeter class to WelcomeGreeter across the codebase.

expectations: Does not invoke kit-overengineering-review (kit-refactoring, which makes the change, fits)
